title: CraftControl
description: Visually build custom Crafting, Smelting, and Smithing recipes using in-game GUIs! Features a master UI to edit/delete recipes, global daily crafting limits, dupe protection, and the ability to block vanilla recipes.
body:
# 🛠️ CraftControl - The Ultimate Custom Recipe Manager

## Premium Version Releasing Soon

Tired of messing with complicated data packs, bloated JSON files, and tedious reloads just to add a single custom recipe to your server? **Say goodbye to the hassle.** 

**CraftControl** puts the power of custom crafting right into the palm of your hands through an incredibly intuitive, zero-lag in-game GUI. Whether you're building an RPG server, a hardcore survival experience, or just want to add a fun twist for your players, CraftControl makes recipe management a breeze!

---

## ✨ Why Choose CraftControl?

### 🎨 Visual In-Game GUI Builders
No more code! Simply type a command, drop your items into the custom interface, choose your result, and hit save. It's really that simple.
- `/ccrecipe` — Build traditional Shaped or Shapeless crafting table recipes.
- `/ccfurnace` — Create unique smelting paths for the Furnace.
- `/ccsmithing` — Design epic gear upgrades using the Smithing Table.

### ⚔️ Flawless Custom Item Support
Want to craft a *Legendary Flaming Broadsword* with custom lore, unbreakable tags, and crazy enchantments? CraftControl saves exact item metadata perfectly. Whatever you put in the result slot is exactly what your players will get.

### 🛡️ Iron-Clad Exploit Prevention
Server economy and fairness are our top priorities. CraftControl features a bulletproof validation system designed to aggressively prevent ghost items, shift-click duplication glitches, and crafting exploits. 

### ⚡ Lightweight & Blazing Fast
Optimized for Minecraft 1.21, CraftControl operates silently in the background with absolutely zero impact on your server's TPS.

---

## ⚙️ Commands & Permissions
- `/craftcontrol reload` — Reload the configuration instantly without restarting. *(Permission: `craftcontrol.reload`)*
- `/ccrecipe` — Open the Recipe Builder GUI. *(Permission: `craftcontrol.build`)*
- `/ccfurnace` — Open the Furnace Builder GUI. *(Permission: `craftcontrol.build`)*
- `/ccsmithing` — Open the Smithing Builder GUI. *(Permission: `craftcontrol.build`)*

## 🚀 Getting Started
1. Drop `CraftControl.jar` into your `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server.
3. Grant yourself OP or the required permissions.
4. Run `/ccrecipe` and let your imagination run wild!
